snippet.title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity – Definitive Edition – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity – Definitive Edition comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on Feb 25, 2027. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/hyrule-warriors-age-of-calamity-definitive-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Experience the events of the Great Calamity that took place 100 years before the Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild game.

Enjoy enhanced visuals and frame rate, as well as battles featuring more enemies on screen. All content from the Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity Expansion Pass is also included.

If you have the Nintendo Switch version, you can get a discount on the digital Nintendo Switch 2 game on Nintendo eShop—plus, transfer your existing save data!

#NintendoDirect #HyruleWarriors 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
